# Danny Phan

> Danny Phan is a security operations and automation engineer based in Hanoi, Vietnam. This site is his project hub.

## Projects

- [antiRea](https://antirea.dannyphan.me/): Open-source TypeScript library that meters dataset access per identity and flags coordinated bot abuse for web apps and SaaS. Server-side, zero dependencies, advisory only. Current release: 3.0.0, MIT license. npm: @dannyphan190/anti-rea.
- BaoAnSearch: Pharmaceutical product search and catalog tooling (internal tool).
- [3Dlabobo](https://3dlabobo.dannyphan.me/): Interactive 3D lab series in the browser - Lab 01 Cat Jelly Press (hydraulic press, jelly cats, up to 400 bar) and Lab 02 Mecha Cat Teardown (subsystem teardown, X-Ray, exploded views, live telemetry). Three.js, one HTML file per lab.
- News Translator: AI-curated news translation and automated publishing pipeline (AI curation, translation, Playwright posting).
